DOCUMENT_STRUCTURE.DESCRIPTION: Guardian FOURTH PEO / CHOICEAP invoices have TWO main data sections that OVERLAP in content. The extractor MUST handle them correctly to avoid doubling premiums.

SECTIONS.NAME: Summary of Activity (Page 1)
SECTIONS.CONTENT: Summary table with coverage totals. SKIP for line items - use only for HEADER (INV_DATE, INV_NUMBER etc.)
SECTIONS.ACTION: HEADER ONLY - do NOT extract line items

SECTIONS.NAME: Premium Adjustments Since Last Bill (Pages 2-6)
SECTIONS.CONTENT: Lists NEW employees added since last bill. Each employee has one or more coverages with New Premium and Premium Adjustment columns.
SECTIONS.ACTION: Extract each coverage as a separate line item. Map 'New Premium' -> CURRENT_PREMIUM, 'Premium Adjustment' -> ADJUSTMENT_PREMIUM. Set BILLING_PERIOD to the Eff. Date (05/01/26).

COVERAGE (Emp=EE, Fam=FAM, Emp/Sp=ES, Emp/Ch=EC, Sp=ES, Ch=EC)

SECTIONS.NAME: Current Premiums (Pages 7-9)
SECTIONS.CONTENT: Wide multi-column table showing ALL employees' current premiums across all plans. CRITICAL: Employees who already appeared in the Adjustments section will appear here too with the SAME premium values.
SECTIONS.ACTION: Extract each non-zero plan as a separate line item. Set ADJUSTMENT_PREMIUM=null for all rows from this section. Set BILLING_PERIOD to the current billing period (06/01/26).
TABLE_COLUMNS_IN_ORDER: Col15: TotalPremium (IGNORE this — it is the row sum)
CRITICAL_RULES: RULE A: Use PIPE DELIMITERS (|) to count column positions. Each | separates one column. The plan is determined ONLY by position, NEVER by the value.
RULE B: Col8 is ALWAYS Std (Short Term Disability). Do NOT confuse it with Vision. Vision is Col9.
RULE C: Col11 is ALWAYS VoluntaryAd&D. Col13 is ALWAYS VoluntaryTermLife. Do NOT confuse these with Vision.
RULE D: Empty cells (| | or |     |) mean the employee does NOT have that plan — do NOT create a row for it.
RULE E: Col15 (TotalPremium) is the row sum — NEVER extract it as a plan. It always starts with $.

RULE F — MULTI-TIER CELLS: Col11 and Col13 may contain MULTIPLE premium+volume pairs on the SAME LINE, e.g., '2.50 100,000 1.25 50,000 0.50 10,000'. This means Emp=2.50 (vol 100k), Sp=1.25 (vol 50k), Ch=0.50 (vol 10k). You MUST SUM the premiums: 2.50+1.25+0.50=4.25. The coverage tiers are in Col12/Col14 as 'Emp Sp Ch'.
RULE G — MULTI-LINE ROWS: Some employees span 2 lines. The second line contains volume data (e.g., '10,000' or '865'). This is just metadata — it does NOT create a new plan row.
RULE H — COVERAGE TIER: When multiple tiers appear (Emp Sp Ch), use the broadest tier: 3 tiers=FAM, 2 tiers with Sp=ES, 2 tiers with Ch=EC.

MERGE_RULES.CRITICAL: DO NOT SUM premiums from the Adjustments section with the Current Premiums section for the same employee+plan. They represent the SAME charge, not additive charges.
MERGE_RULES.RULE_1: If an employee+plan appears in BOTH sections with the SAME CURRENT_PREMIUM value, keep ONLY the Adjustments row (which has both CURRENT_PREMIUM and ADJUSTMENT_PREMIUM populated).
MERGE_RULES.RULE_2: If an employee appears ONLY in the Current Premiums section (no Adjustments entry), keep that row with ADJUSTMENT_PREMIUM=null.
MERGE_RULES.RULE_3: The Adjustments section uses the Eff. Date as BILLING_PERIOD (e.g., 5/1/2026). The Current Premiums section uses the current billing period (e.g., 6/1/2026).

Specified Arch: No Life or Std. FAM dental + ES vision.

Do NOT create Vision from the 2.50 — it is Ad&D.
